Living a Zen Life

A Guide

What does it mean to live a Zen life?

I actually have no real idea. These are just my thoughts.

The following are my qualifications:

  • I've been told I am Zen
  • Sometimes brain is empty
  • La la la la
  • I feel little stress

Why am I making this guide?

  • Everyone around me is stressing
  • I need to self reflect
  • I am running out of ideas
  • My cousin asked me where I got the ability to chill out from
  • Because I can show off some of my photography
